## Checklist

- [ ] `./mvnw verify` passes locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated (see the table in CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] SQL changes made in **both** `db/mysql` and `db/mssql`
- [ ] Generated files regenerated if needed (UML, seed data, screenshots)
- [ ] Docs updated (README / `docs/`) if behaviour or setup changed
- [ ] No secrets or real personal data in the diff
